name: Phasmo Journal — Voice Hotkeys
description: Global hotkeys for the Phasmo Journal voice assistant page (push-to-talk, mute, undo) that work even while Phasmophobia has window focus.

ptt-toggle.description: Start/stop AI voice recording on the Phasmo Journal voice page

mute-toggle.description: Mute/unmute spoken responses on the Phasmo Journal voice page

undo-last.description: Undo the last command on the Phasmo Journal voice page
